entities.summary:
Gevherhan Hatun (unknown–1514) was an Ottoman princess and the full-sister of Sultan Bayezid II.


As the daughter of Sultan Mehmed II and Gülbahar Hatun, Gevherhan Hatun played a significant role in Ottoman politics and diplomacy.


During her lifetime, Gevherhan Hatun was involved in various power struggles and negotiations between the Ottoman Empire and its neighbors, including the Byzantine Empire and the Safavid Empire.


Her legacy as a prominent figure in Ottoman history is still studied and debated by scholars today.


"A true Ottoman princess, with a heart full of courage and a spirit that can conquer any challenge."
